name: marrow-phase
description: Ship one Marrow spec phase: implement, review in parallel with the project's custom agents, fix until approved (max 2 rounds), then open the PR.

steps.prompt: Implement tasks {{tasks}} of .kiro/specs/{{spec}}/tasks.md on a new branch. Follow .kiro/steering. Tick finished tasks. Run npm run typecheck, npm test and npm run build at the repo root; all must pass. Finish with a short summary of what changed.

branches.prompt: Point at .kiro/specs/{{spec}}/design.md. Add any missing fast-check tests for its numbered correctness properties that tasks {{tasks}} touch, run npm test, and report each property as covered, added, or FAILING with its shrunk counterexample.
Review the files changed on this branch against .kiro/steering/accessibility.md and the privacy rule (no camera data leaves the device). List findings as file:line with a fix, or say NO FINDINGS.
Review this branch's changes against .kiro/specs/{{spec}}/requirements.md for behavioral bugs and missing edge cases. List findings with file:line, or say NO FINDINGS.

steps.prompt:
If the review ends with VERDICT: APPROVED, change nothing and say so. Otherwise fix every failing property and P0/P1 finding without weakening any property test, rerun typecheck, test and build, and commit.

{{aggregate.output}}
Open a pull request to main for this branch titled after the phase. The body says Closes #{{issue}}, lists tasks {{tasks}}, and includes the final aggregated review.
